title: GSI Monetary Valuation Tool (gsivt), version 3.3
description: Python engine, workbook interface, tests and the bundled spreadsheet tool (version 3.3) for benefit-cost analysis of green stormwater infrastructure with the nutrient crediting methods of the Florida ERP Applicant's Handbook Volume I (2024). The manuals, validation workbook and evaluation scripts are archived in a separate, linked Zenodo record.
notes: This cooperative project was funded in part by the United States Environmental Protection Agency and the Florida Department of Environmental Protection under Agreement NF116 (Task 2).
